reader.requirement: Absent parentheses, consecutive operations of one hierarchical level (addition/subtraction, multiplication/division, exponentiation) execute left to right, and parentheses override the GR1 hierarchy (unary, exponentiation, multiplication/division, addition/subtraction) in every arithmetic expression (COMPUTE, relation operands, function arguments).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.NegativeBaseRequiresIntegerExponent: the negative-base exponentiation rule (GR5c at 85), not the order of execution; the left fold is the same at every edition

reader.edition-search: The grammar tiers and BindChain/BindPower's left folds take no edition; the one DialectBehaviors call on the path (BindPower) selects the negative-base rule only. grep Edition|DialectBehavior in the expression spine.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: func_expr_arg covers left-folding ** and compound function arguments; subtraction/division chains, mixed * / chains, unary-over-power and nested parentheses are not exercised.

reader.notes: The grammar gives one tier per hierarchical level with a repeated tail, and BindChain/BindPower fold each tier from the left, so same-level operations run left to right, exponentiation included. Probe classes b, c and e do not apply: the rule states an order, not a refusal or an edition-only form.
